notes: Flytrap: alien Venus-flytrap bio-weapon. Left click = Bite (the head launches on its stem, chomps the first body it reaches, rips a chunk out, retracts). Right click = Spit (arcing poison glob, small splash, poison damage over time, sizzling puddle). No reload, no aim-down-sights, no aim assist. Distances in metres, times in seconds, damage in HP (players have 100). Read by modules/w_flytrap.js at load; the module has the same numbers built in as a fallback.

weapon.name: Flytrap
weapon.desc: Alive and hungry. Left click: the head shoots out up to 14 m and rips a chunk out of whoever it bites. Right click: spits poison that keeps eating them.
